summary: Verified ElevenLabs API key update in /app/backend/.env. .env now contains the new hex key (7a8a152c169e545441b8fadca2fd101deab162b88a3d524612720e99b1a6caf9) and voice ID ibbx9zDYGvLgtYzRbqqG. Backend picks it up (TTS endpoint returns HTTP 200, ~10KB audio/mpeg). HOWEVER, ElevenLabs is NOT actually working — every TTS request logs 'ElevenLabs failed (ElevenLabs 400)' and falls back to OpenAI onyx. ElevenLabs itself is explicitly telling us the value is an API key *ID*, not the API key. User must supply the real API key value that starts with 'sk_'.

critical.issue: ElevenLabs primary TTS returns HTTP 400 with message: {"detail":{"type":"authentication_error","code":"invalid_api_key","message":"API key ID used as API key - only valid API keys can be used. API keys start with 'sk_' and are shown when the key is created."}}. Endpoint still returns 200 because it falls back to OpenAI onyx voice. The new ELEVENLABS_API_KEY value (7a8a152c...) is an API key ID, not a valid API key.

action_items: Ask the user for the actual ElevenLabs API KEY (a secret string starting with 'sk_' shown once at key-creation time). The value 7a8a152c169e545441b8fadca2fd101deab162b88a3d524612720e99b1a6caf9 is the public API key ID, not the secret.

Once real 'sk_...' key is provided, replace ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env, run `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, then hit /api/assistant/tts/stream and confirm backend logs no longer show '[TTS] ElevenLabs failed' and no '[TTS] Using OpenAI ... fallback'.
critical_code_review_comments: TTS fallback design masks upstream failure — /api/assistant/tts/stream returns 200 even when the ElevenLabs auth fails. Consider surfacing a header like X-TTS-Provider (elevenlabs|openai) so the client and QA can easily verify which engine served the audio without grepping logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ElevenLabs key update NOT successful — new value is an API key ID, not the actual key. Endpoint returns 200 only due to OpenAI onyx fallback. Wait for a real 'sk_'-prefixed key from user before retesting.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: The value the user provided (7a8a152c...) is the ElevenLabs API key *ID* (a public identifier shown in the ElevenLabs dashboard), not the actual secret API key. Real ElevenLabs API keys begin with 'sk_' and are only shown once at creation time. Evidence: backend logs at 2026-08-10 10:30:04 and 10:31:04 show ElevenLabs HTTP 400 with message 'API key ID used as API key - only valid API keys can be used. API keys start with sk_ and are shown when the key is created.' Reproduction: `curl -s http://localhost:8001/api/assistant/tts/stream?text=Verify&voice=onyx -o /tmp/tts.mp3 -w '%{http_code}'` → 200 (from onyx fallback); `tail /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log` → ElevenLabs 400. Mitigation: user must retrieve the actual secret key from the ElevenLabs dashboard (or regenerate one — the sk_ value is only visible at creation) and paste that into ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, then restart backend.
